# Tracking Trump’s Cabinet picks Here's who has a seat at the table
By POLITICO Staff 11/12/2024 07:06 AM MST|Updated03/27/2025 01:09 PM MDT President Donald Trump is beginning to fill his Cabinet, the members of which will help implement his priorities. Despite concerns about the qualifications of some of Trump's Cabinet nominees, every single secretary position has now been filled and only a handful of Cabinet-level roles remain unconfirmed. Trump has withdrawn two nominees from ... for attorney general. The second was Rep. Elise Stefanik’s nomination to be United Nations ambassador amid worries about the House’s narrow GOP majority. The most controversial confirmation proved to be Pete Hegseth , who faced accusations of alcoholism, sexual assault and lack of experience. He lost the support of three Republican senators and was confirmed on Jan. 24 with a tie-breaking vote from Vice President JD Vance. This is POLITICO’s guide to Trump’s Cabinet picks including roles considered Cabinet-level in recent administrations.
